newsitem.title: ITALY: Palermo politician arrested on Mafia suspicion.
newsitem.headline: Palermo politician arrested on Mafia suspicion.

text.p: A Sicilian politician and former president of the Palermo soccer club was arrested on suspicion of collusion with the Mafia on Friday, police said.

They said Liborio Polizzi, 48, a centre-left councillor for sport and tourism in the Palermo provincial government, was suspected of providing safe housing for self-confessed Mafia killer Salvatore Cucuzza.

Cucuzza, who was arrested last year, has admitted he took part in several murders, including that in 1982 of Pio La Torre, leader in Sicily of the now-defunct Italian Communist Party and a former president of the island's regional government.
Polizzi entered politics in 1996, a year after he was sacked as president of Palermo soccer club.
